name: print-social-burgundy-grid-services-pills-poster
title: Burgundy Services Pills Post
whatItIs: A burgundy portrait post with a faint pink grid and grain, a short logo, a circular back arrow, a huge pale pink 'OUR SERVICES' with a small underlined 'Work with us', six service pills alternating solid pink and gold outline, and a URL and handle at the base.
whatItMeans: Heavy pale type on deep burgundy is bold and elegant, and pills make a list into friendly tags.
techniques: Huge heavy caps headline in pale pink
Faint grid and grain over flat burgundy
URL and handle at opposite base corners

vocabulary.definition: A rounded label naming an offering.
A pill drawn as an outline rather than filled.
Fine noise texture over a flat colour.
